title: Low-Rank Kolmogorov-Arnold Generator Flows for Interpretable Operator Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13028v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators that learn physical laws from data should generalize beyond their training distribution and expose the learned law in closed form. The Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator achieves both for position-dependent dynamics by learning a dense pseudo-differential symbol over all positions and frequencies, at a cost that grows with the square of the resolution and with closed forms that must be read out by hand. This dense symbol is unnecessary: a finite-order variable-coefficient differential operator has a symbol whose separation rank is bounded by the number of its coefficient functions, independently of the resolution, and the symbols that this network learns on its own benchmarks have rank two. translated_title: 用于可解释算子学习的低秩Kolmogorov-Arnold生成元流
translated_abstract: 从数据中学习物理定律的神经算子应当能够泛化到训练分布之外，并以闭合形式呈现所学到的定律。Kolmogorov-Arnold神经算子通过在所有位置和频率上学习一个稠密的伪微分符号（symbol），在这两方面均有所实现，但其计算代价随分辨率的平方增长，且其闭合形式必须依靠人工读出。本文指出这种稠密符号是不必要的：有限阶变系数微分算子的符号，其分离秩由系数函数的个数所界定，与分辨率无关，而该网络在其自身基准测试上学到的符号秩仅为二。作者提出了Kolmogorov-Arnold流（KAFlow），它将物理算子的生成元学习为由一元Kolmogorov-Arnold函数构建的低秩符号，并通过固定这些函数的规范，使得每一项都具有唯一……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出KAFlow方法，用由一元Kolmogorov-Arnold函数构成、秩受系数函数个数约束的低秩符号来学习物理算子的生成元，从而将算子学习的代价从随分辨率平方增长降下来，并直接获得可解释的闭合形式。
en_tdlr: KAFlow learns the generator of a physical operator as a low-rank symbol built from univariate Kolmogorov-Arnold functions, whose separation rank is bounded by the number of coefficient functions, enabling interpretable operator learning with closed-form readout and reduced cost compared to dense pseudo-differential symbols.
